desc: Implement full solution: d-enumeration with isqrt; disc = 12*(N//d) - 3*d*d; verify perfect square, positivity, and divisibility by 6; print x y or -1
Run the implementation on the three provided samples and confirm exact expected outputs
Brute-force verify small N against the implementation to confirm correctness and the no-solution case
Test boundary values near 10^18 (including the large sample) and confirm performance is within limits
Prove the bound d^3 <= N (so d <= cbrt(N) <= 10^6) and derive the quadratic 3y^2 + 3dy + d^2 = N/d
Decide the primary approach: d-enumeration with exact integer quadratic solving (chosen over Pollard Rho, Eisenstein factorization, and alternate change of variables)
